header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner; nor intimation received.
body: This petition was filed in year 2022 with the prayer to restore vacant possession of Survey No.77 admeasuring 4.30 acres, situated in Deh Panhwarki Taluka Mirpurkhas, to the petitioner. Further perusal of contents of instant petition reflects that there is civil dispute between private parties, for which alternate remedy i.e to approach civil court, is available; hence instant petition being non-maintainable is hereby dismissed.
